parent_ledger: Existing elf-real-project-pilot campaign ledger; not reset
reader_output: answer plus citations containing exact quote and native handle
conditions: Native knowledge ingestion and native session-memory extraction; same shared reader after native retrieval. No claim of complete native Agent UI acceptance.

elf_transport.knowledge: Native docs_put(doc_type=knowledge), docs_search_l0 top_k=6 candidate_k=60, read returned chunks through docs_excerpts.
elf_transport.memory: Original user messages stored as doc_type=chat; native events_ingest with exact source_document, full byte span, message ID, and supplied timestamp. No hand-authored notes or keys.
elf_transport.scope: Both named projects share one native project and agent namespace; calibration uses separate containers and volumes.
elf_transport.retrieval: Native planned_search top_k=6 candidate_k=60 and evidence_pack. No oracle subjects, date filters, fallback original searches, or follow-up reader calls.
elf_transport.rerank: Existing local-token-overlap, as in ELF reference runtime; no extra paid reranker.
elf_transport.source_hydration: Only parents returned by native evidence_pack; all-source audit is separate from answer context.
elf_transport.embedding_reuse: Exact request matches only, from the existing 4096-dimensional provider receipts; no chat response reuse.
elf_transport.configuration: Current elf.example.toml defaults; native per-note and aggregate admission, MMR, query planning remain unchanged.
elf_transport.runtime: Native ARM64 binaries built from current source, PostgreSQL and Qdrant Docker stores; no product speed ranking.
